messages:
sam: quick ask — support needs to reproduce a hard-to-debug failure for a single Dedicated customer (acct-42). Can we get a 2h one-off capture of request+response bodies for /v1/infer to diagnose? We’d encrypt and store in a restricted s3 bucket and delete after analysis.

anna: what fields exactly would you capture? full prompt & full model output? any attachments?

sam: full HTTP body for the requests and responses for that route only. No attachments. We'll redact emails/phone numbers before write if possible but might need raw to ensure repro.

cory: fwiw we try to avoid full-body captures in prod. Alternatives: 1) capture prompt hash + prompt snippet + metadata, 2) reproduce in staging with sampled input, 3) get customer consent.

maya: agree with cory. If we must capture, security needs: explicit customer consent OR legal approval, HMAC of user-id rather than storing clear user-id, ephemeral S3 bucket with object ACLs restricted to an allowlist, server-side KMS encryption, and audit log for access. TTL 7 days preferred, 30 days max with strong justification.

sam: understood. For this case customer already agreed to help debug (support email thread). I can prepare the consent snippet and an allowlist. Would 2h window with a 7-day TTL work?

maya: probably. Need the consent email included and the allowlist (IAM principals). Also we require a brief runbook: who will access, where results stored, deletion steps, and a rollback if we accidentally capture extra customers.

security-bot: Reminder: capture requests requiring PII in prod must be pre-approved by eng-security + legal. Use the "ephemeral-capture" feature and tag the capture with an audit token. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ephemeral-capture for checklist.

cory: quick config suggestion — set the capture filter to only acct=acct-42 and route=/v1/infer, and use post-processing to run a scrubber. Example capture rule: ```json
{
  "filter": {"customer_id": "acct-42", "path": "/v1/infer"},
  "post_process": ["redact_emails", "redact_phones", "trim_full_text_to_2k"],
  "storage": {"type": "s3", "bucket": "redwood-ephemeral-debug", "kms": "projects/redwood/kms/ephemeral"},
  "ttl": "7d"
}
```

sam: perfect. I'll draft the approval request with the consent email and IAM allowlist + runbook and ping eng-security & legal. If someone from security can pre-review the runbook now that'd be great. :thumbsup:

maya: I can review in ~30m. Please @mention me in the ticket and attach the support thread for context.

sam: thanks all — will post the ticket shortly and include the capture rule and scrubber steps. :lock:
